papers.title: Procedural Memory Distillation: Online Reflection for Self-Improving Language Models
authors: Ye Liu, Srijan Bansal, Bo Pang, Yang Li, Zeyu Leo Liu, Yifei Ming, Zixuan Ke, Shafiq Joty, Semih Yavuz
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), along with recent selfdistillation variants such as SDPO, evaluates each rollout against a verifier and updates the policy from that episode-level signal. However, the richer procedural information in the rollout is rarely retained or reused. Across episodes and epochs, the model repeatedly encounters related problems under a changing policy, producing cross-episode signals that episode-local updates cannot capture: which strategies consiste
papers.llm_reason: 今日最强信号：Procedural Memory Distillation 把 RLVR 的『逐 episode 标量信号』升级为『跨 episode 的程序性记忆』。理论根基＝认知科学的程序性记忆（procedural memory，即『如何做』的技能记忆，区别于陈述性事实记忆）与 LLM 的 cross-episode learning。核心洞察：RLVR/SDPO 每个 rollout 只产生 episode 级标量奖励，但 rollout 内部丰富的程序性信息（哪种策略持续奏效、哪种反复失败、哪类子问题的解法可复用）被丢弃；本文用在线反思把这些跨 episode 程序性信号蒸馏成可检索、可复用的程序性记忆。理论命题清晰且可证伪——『保留并复用 rollout 程序性信息比纯 episode-local 更新在下游任务上更高效』可通过『记忆通道开关』做对照实验量化。工程映射直接：任何做 agent RL 的团队都可在 verifier 之外加一条『程序性记忆通道』——把成功 rollout 的有效子策略抽象成可检索技能、把反复失败的模式沉淀成回避规则，再在后续 episode 检索复用。作者（Ye Liu、Srijan Bansal、Bo Pang、Shafiq Joty、Semih Yavuz 等，Salesforce AI Research）在 agent/记忆/RL 方向高度可信。减分项：代码/benchmark/复现入口暂无（待核验），故不给 90+；但即便无官方代码也能自建最小验证（在 RLVR 基线上加『成功 rollout→程序性记忆→后续 episode 检索复用』通道，对比纯 verifier 信号基线）。

papers.title: Beyond Next-Token Prediction: An RLVR Proof of Concept for Tool-Use Agents on Atlassian Workflows
authors: Karthikeya Aditya Vissa, Sankalp Mane, Ananya Mantravadi, Harshit Rajgarhia, Abhishek Mukherji
papers.abstract: Large language models are trained to predict the next token, not to act inside a specific API. In niche enterprise SaaS workflows -- where success means hitting the right endpoint with the right nested arguments in the right order -- this objective mismatch shows up as silent failures: dropped required fields, hallucinated tools, or early stops after a single read. We ask whether Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), applied directly in the target environment, closes the gap. As
papers.llm_reason: RL 后训练落地企业 SaaS 的关键 PoC：LLM 被训练去预测下一 token 而非『在特定 API 内行动』，这一目标错配在细分企业工作流里表现为沉默失败——漏填必填字段、幻觉工具、读一次就提前停止。本文直接在目标环境内用 RLVR（可验证奖励）缩小 next-token 与 action 之间的差距。理论命题清晰可证伪：『在目标环境内做 RLVR 比纯 SFT/提示更能修复 API 调用级错误』可通过端点命中率、参数完整率、调用顺序正确率量化。工程映射＝企业 tool-use agent 的后训练范式——把『是否命中正确端点＋正确嵌套参数＋正确顺序』做成 verifier，在真实 SaaS 环境内训练而非只靠 sandbox 或提示。证据含 Atlassian 真实工作流的 PoC 与对照。给即时分，因属可直接试点的训练范式；代码/benchmark 入口待核验。

papers.title: World Feedback for Clinical Agents: Diagnosing RL in FHIR Environments
authors: Ananya Mantravadi, Harshit Rajgarhia, Prasanna Desikan, Abhishek Mukherji
papers.abstract: Clinical protocol-execution tasks -- checking a lab value, applying a threshold, placing a correctly structured FHIR order -- are natural candidates for RL from world feedback: once clinical SMEs encode decision logic into a verifier, that verifier grades unlimited rollouts without per-episode annotation. But applying RL requires a sound feedback channel and sufficient base capability. We audit MedAgentBench v1/v2, find a 41.7\% silent-finish ceiling that makes inaction the RL dominant strategy,
papers.llm_reason: 高证据强度的诊断型研究：审计 MedAgentBench v1/v2 发现 41.7% 的『沉默完成天花板（silent-finish ceiling）』——agent 在未完成必要动作时就静默停止，使『不作为』成为 RL 的主导策略。这对所有做 agent RL 的团队是即时警讯：你的 verifier/奖励通道是否健康，直接决定 RL 学到的是『行动』还是『不行动』。理论命题可证伪——『基准的沉默完成率决定了 RL 能否学到有效行动而非不作为』可通过沉默率与 RL 收益的相关性验证。工程映射＝agent RL 上线前的『反馈通道健康度审计』——上线 RLVR 前先测基准 silent-finish 率并修复，否则会训出『学会不做』的 agent。给趋势分而非即时分，因属强诊断研究、需确认该天花板结论是否跨基准泛化；代码/benchmark 入口待核验。

papers.title: When Should Service Agents Reconsider? Difficulty-Routed Control in Customer-Service Operations
authors: Qian Chen, Chengyuan Liu, Xin Yu
papers.abstract: Autonomous customer-service agents are shifting from conversational interfaces toward operational execution roles: they retrieve firm records, apply service policies, and execute backend writes such as refunds, cancellations, exchanges, order modifications, and reservation changes. This shift creates a service-control problem: firms must keep routine service fast and low-friction while preventing operational errors on requests where customer instructions, policy constraints, firm records, and ba
papers.llm_reason: 客服 agent 从『对话界面』走向『运营执行』（检索记录、应用策略、执行退款/取消/改单等后端写操作）带来的服务控制问题：既要让常规请求快速低摩擦，又要防止在客户指令、策略约束、企业记录三者冲突时出错。本文提出『难度路由控制』——按请求难度动态调节 agent 的复核/放行阈值。理论命题可证伪：『按难度路由控制比统一阈值更能兼顾速度与正确率』可通过误操作率与处理时延双指标量化。工程映射＝operational agent 的安全控制层——把『何时该让人复核、何时该直接执行』做成难度感知的路由器，而非一刀切的人工审核或全自动放行。给趋势分，因属控制策略设计、需确认难度估计的准确率与误操作权衡；代码/benchmark 待核验。

papers.title: Agent4cs: A Multi-agent System for Code Summarization in Large Hierarchical Codebases
authors: Yongjian Tang, Ezgi Sarikayak, Doruk Tuncel, Jie M. Zhang, Thomas Runkler
papers.abstract: Understanding large, complex codebases, especially those with obfuscated structures and incomplete documentation, remains a significant challenge. Existing code summarization solutions often rely on a single language model or coding assistant like Claude Code, and treat source code as flat text, underutilizing the rich interdependencies and hierarchical information within a repository. To address these shortcomings, we propose Agent4cs - a multi-agent framework that summarizes large codebases in
papers.llm_reason: 代码理解 agent 的重要工程研究：现有方案（单一 LLM 或 Claude Code 等）把源码当扁平文本，未利用大型仓库的层级结构与依赖关系。Agent4cs 用多智能体框架在层级代码库上做摘要——显式利用 interdependencies 与 hierarchical 信息。理论命题＝层级化多智能体分解比扁平单模型更能理解大型代码库（可通过摘要质量/下游检索命中率验证）。工程映射＝大型遗留代码库的自动文档与理解——把『仓库→子系统→模块→函数』的层级分解交给多 agent 协作处理。作者含 Jie M. papers.title: Auto-FL-Research: Agentic Search for Federated Learning Algorithms
authors: Holger R. Roth, Ziyue Xu, Chester Chen, Daguang Xu, Peter Cnudde, Andrew Feng
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) research often depends on many small but consequential algorithmic choices: optimizer variants, server aggregation rules, local training schedules, normalization, regularization, and model architecture. These choices are expensive to explore manually and difficult to compare fairly when candidate changes can also alter the FL training or evaluation path. In this work, we present Auto-FL-Research (AFR), a constrained coding-agent workflow for FL algorithmic recipe search.
papers.llm_reason: 把 coding-agent 范式从『写代码』扩展到『做 ML 研究』：FL（联邦学习）算法配方搜索（optimizer/聚合规则/本地训练调度/归一化/正则/模型架构）手工探索昂贵且难公平比较，AFR 用受约束的 coding-agent workflow 自动搜索算法配方。理论命题＝『agentic search 能比人工调参/网格搜索更高效地发现有效 FL 配方』（可通过配方搜索的帕累托效率与成本验证）。工程映射＝coding agent 的研究自动化应用——把『LLM-as-experimenter』模式从软件工程迁移到 ML 实验自动化，这是『agent 自主做研究』方向的具体落地。作者（Holger Roth、Ziyue Xu、Chester Chen、Daguang Xu 等，NVIDIA 医学影像/MONAI 团队）在 FL 方向高度可信。给趋势分，因属应用范式、需确认搜索效率是否优于贝叶斯优化等强基线；代码/benchmark 待核验。

authors: Max Van Puyvelde, Halil Ibrahim Gulluk, Wim Van Criekinge, Olivier Gevaert
papers.abstract: Diffusion language models, which generate text by denoising a token canvas bidirectionally instead of emitting tokens left to right, have become competitive with autoregressive (AR) generation. Medical foundation models, however, remain almost entirely autoregressive. papers.llm_reason: 非自回归生成范式进入医学领域：扩散语言模型（双向去噪而非从左到右）已接近 AR 生成竞争力，但医学基础模型几乎全是 AR。本文适配 DiffusionGemma-26B（MoE 扩散 LM）并在相同 LoRA 配方下对比其 AR 兄弟 Gemma-4-26B，由 verifier 评分。价值在于『扩散 LM 在领域落地』的可行性信号，但属医学影像报告细分领域、与雷达 LLM/Agent/推理主线相关性外围。代码/benchmark 待核验。

authors: Pavel Iakovets, Liyanapathiranage Sudeepika Wajirakumari Samarathunga, Martin Thomas Horsch, Fadi Al Machot
papers.abstract: Counterfactual explanations explain machine learning predictions by identifying minimal input changes that would alter a model's decision. Although many existing methods successfully generate prediction-changing alternatives, they often produce unrealistic or infeasible recommendations due to a lack of explicit mechanisms for incorporating domain knowledge and intervention constraints. Neuro-symbolic AI offers a promising direction by combining data-driven predictive models with symbolic reasoni
papers.llm_reason: 神经符号 AI 用于反事实解释（XAI）：现有反事实方法生成的『最小输入改动』建议常不现实或不可行，PACE 用神经符号方法结合领域知识与干预约束，生成『合理且可操作』的反事实解释。方法论价值在于『可操作性/可行性约束下的反事实生成』，对可解释性/合规场景有参考；但与雷达 LLM/Agent/训练主线相关性外围。代码/benchmark 待核验。

authors: Aryuemaan Kumar Chowdhury, Afreen Shaik, Yaparla Bhargavi, Brahma Kumar
